assertionsTested.reason: Overview showed the executive summary with completion percentage and visible Done, In Progress, Blocked, and Total counts in the default state.
Summary metrics recomputed from 22/71/0/101 in overview to 6/31/0/41 in goal scope and then to 0/1/0/1 under combined department+team+status+search narrowing.
Goal cards showed labels, progress, and stale signals, but they never surfaced blocked counts or blocked-owner names even though six visible rows were marked 'At risk'.

Clicking goal card 2 scoped the page in place: summary changed to 41 updates, the table narrowed to that goal, the scope indicator appeared, and the selected/non-selected goal cards received active vs dimmed styling.
Reset returned the dashboard from scoped/narrowed states to the full overview with the original 101-row dataset and cleared visible scope state.
Freshness did not reliably reflect sheet-update recency: the header badge stayed at 'Live · update date unavailable' even though rows had dated updates and goal cards were marked stale.
The dedicated blocked section stayed hidden in overview even though six visible rows were labeled 'At risk', so the canonical blocked callout was absent.
Blocked visibility never responded to active subsets because the blocked section remained hidden in overview, goal scope, department scope, and combined filtered states.
The current dataset never produced a fully complete goal card, so there was no qualifying complete/no-blocked goal to verify this assertion against.
The search input stayed visible and narrowed visible results without form submission, reducing the active GA + Comms subset to one matching row for 'settlement'.
After choosing Department = GA + Comms, the Team filter narrowed from the global list to the valid department teams only: Comms, Gov't Affairs, and RTB.
Department, Team, Status, and Search applied conjunctively and produced exactly one matching row: Jorge Colindres / Govt Settlement Talks.
Clicking the GA + Comms department header scoped the detail view in place, updated summary metrics, and showed a matching department scope indicator.
Scoped states displayed a visible indicator with explanatory text and a clear 'Clear scope' dismiss action.
Reset cleared search text, filter values, and scope together, restoring the default overview counts and removing the filter badge and scope indicator.
Goal scope, department scope, combined filters/search, reset, and refresh all stayed on the same location: http://127.0.0.1:3100/index.html with no hash or query changes.
Goal scope updated summary, table, and scope indicator together, but the blocked section did not update to that subset and stayed hidden despite 'At risk' rows within goal 2.

Department scope + search + reset returned summary and table to overview, but the blocked section never surfaced either before or after reset even though overview still contained visible 'At risk' rows.

Refreshing during a narrowed state left an incoherent post-refresh UI: the loading message persisted over loaded content, scope text remained while scope visibility was false, and the narrowed filters stayed active.
evidence: stateMessageAfterRefresh:Fetching latest data from Google Sheets…

assertionsTested.reason: The end-to-end interaction path stayed within one document with no navigation event: load, goal scope, department scope, search/filter, refresh, and reset all occurred in place.

frictions.description: The live sheet fetch was slow to settle and the loading banner remained visible over already-rendered content during manual checks, which made refresh-state timing harder to judge.
frictions.resolution: Waited for network idle and captured both in-progress and settled screenshots before deciding outcomes.

blockers.description: The current dataset did not include a fully complete goal card, so the complete-goal/no-blocked-callout case could not be exercised.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Surveyed all four goal cards in overview; percentages were 0%, 15%, 22%, and 44%, so no qualifying goal existed.

summary: Validated 20 assertions for overview/scope on the live browser UI: 11 passed, 8 failed, and 1 was blocked. Main failures were blocked-risk handling (at-risk rows never surfaced as blocked), freshness header accuracy, and refresh coherence while narrowed.
